scope.definition: Primary display universe: UCLs with 100-1,499 usual residents, excluding special/non-settlement records. This is a Tiny Towns Atlas product definition, not an ABS definition of a town. The published diabetes analysis this Atlas builds on used a lower bound of 200 residents.

diabetes_pct.label: Census-reported diabetes
diabetes_pct.description: Share of usual residents who told the Census they have been diagnosed with diabetes by a doctor or nurse.
diabetes_pct.definition: Usual residents reporting diabetes (excluding gestational diabetes) as a long-term health condition in the 2021 Census, out of all usual residents.
caveats: Census-reported diagnosed long-term diabetes, not clinical prevalence.
Excludes gestational diabetes; does not identify diabetes type or severity.
Not age-standardised: towns with older populations will tend to show higher rates.
Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.
diabetes_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

cancer_pct.label: Census-reported cancer (including remission)
cancer_pct.description: Share of usual residents who told the Census they have been diagnosed with cancer (including cancer in remission) by a doctor or nurse.
cancer_pct.definition: Usual residents reporting "Cancer (including remission)" as a long-term health condition in the 2021 Census, out of all usual residents.
caveats: A Census-reported long-term condition that includes cancer in remission; not cancer registry incidence and not a clinically measured prevalence estimate.
Does not identify cancer type, stage or when it was diagnosed.
Not age-standardised: towns with older populations will tend to show higher rates.
Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.
cancer_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

asthma_pct.label: Census-reported asthma
asthma_pct.description: Share of usual residents who told the Census they have been diagnosed with asthma by a doctor or nurse.
asthma_pct.definition: Usual residents reporting "Asthma" as a long-term health condition in the 2021 Census, out of all usual residents.
caveats: A Census-reported long-term condition, not a clinical prevalence estimate.
Respondents could mark more than one long-term health condition, so this is not mutually exclusive with the other Census health indicators (e.g. a person may report both asthma and diabetes).
Not age-standardised: differences in age structure affect comparisons.
Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.
asthma_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

caveats: A Census-reported long-term condition, not a clinical prevalence estimate.

Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.
arthritis_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

caveats: A Census-reported long-term condition that includes depression or anxiety; not a clinical prevalence estimate.

Respondents could mark more than one long-term health condition, so this is not mutually exclusive with the other Census health indicators.
Not age-standardised: differences in age structure affect comparisons.
Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.

dementia_pct.label: Census-reported dementia
dementia_pct.description: Share of usual residents who told the Census they have been diagnosed with dementia by a doctor or nurse.
dementia_pct.definition: Usual residents reporting "Dementia (including Alzheimer's)" as a long-term health condition in the 2021 Census, out of all usual residents.
caveats: A Census-reported long-term condition that includes Alzheimer's; not a clinically diagnosed or measured prevalence estimate.
Not age-standardised: towns with older populations will tend to show higher rates, and dementia is strongly age-related.
Respondents could mark more than one long-term health condition, so this is not mutually exclusive with the other Census health indicators.
Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.

indigenous_pct.label: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander population
indigenous_pct.description: Share of usual residents who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.
caveats: Shown as descriptive Census context only.
Not a disease, deficit, or evaluative measure, and not available as a map colour layer.
indigenous_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

degree_pct.label: Degree-level qualification
degree_pct.description: Share of usual residents with a bachelor degree, postgraduate degree, or graduate diploma/certificate.
degree_pct.definition: Out of all usual residents, including children; not an adult attainment rate.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
degree_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

low_income_pct.label: Lower-income households
low_income_pct.description: Share of households in nil-income or lower weekly equivalised-income categories (below $650/week).
low_income_pct.definition: Households with nil or equivalised weekly income below $650, out of all households.
caveats: Household-level share, not a per-person share.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
low_income_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

unemployment_rate_pct.label: Unemployment rate
unemployment_rate_pct.description: Unemployed usual residents as a share of usual residents in the labour force (employed or unemployed, aged 15 and over).
unemployment_rate_pct.definition: Unemployed people out of the labour force (employed + unemployed, aged 15+), as in ABS Census QuickStats for this town. Local Government Area figures cover a wider area and differ.
caveats: Census labour force status in August 2021; not the ABS Labour Force Survey unemployment rate.
The labour force in a tiny town can be a few dozen people, so the rate can move sharply with a handful of people.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
unemployment_rate_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

labour_force_residents_pct.label: In the labour force (of all residents)
labour_force_residents_pct.description: Usual residents in the labour force as a share of all usual residents.
labour_force_residents_pct.definition: Out of all usual residents, including children; lower than the conventional participation rate, which uses people aged 15+.
caveats: Denominator is all usual residents including children, so this is lower than the conventional labour force participation rate.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
labour_force_residents_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

crowded_pct.label: People in crowded dwellings
crowded_pct.description: Share of enumerated people living in crowded dwellings.
crowded_pct.definition: Out of people counted in the town on Census night (place of enumeration), not usual residents.
caveats: Denominator is enumerated population (place counted), not usual residents.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
crowded_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

social_housing_pct.label: People in social housing
social_housing_pct.description: Share of enumerated people in social housing dwellings.
social_housing_pct.definition: Out of people counted in the town on Census night (place of enumeration), not usual residents.
caveats: Denominator is enumerated population (place counted), not usual residents.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
social_housing_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

need_assistance_pct.label: Need for core assistance
need_assistance_pct.description: Share of usual residents needing assistance with core activities (self-care, mobility, communication) due to disability, long-term illness, or old age.
need_assistance_pct.definition: Usual residents needing help with self-care, mobility or communication, out of all usual residents.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
need_assistance_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

born_overseas_nes_pct.label: Born overseas (non-English-speaking country)
born_overseas_nes_pct.description: Share of usual residents born overseas in a predominantly non-English-speaking country.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
born_overseas_nes_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

public_admissions.label: Public hospital admissions
public_admissions.definition: All admissions to public hospitals of residents of the area, excluding same-day admissions for renal dialysis. Repeat admissions and transfers count separately.

pph.label: Potentially preventable hospitalisations
pph.definition: Public hospital admissions for conditions where earlier primary or community care might have prevented the admission (vaccine-preventable, acute and chronic conditions; National Healthcare Agreement PI 18).

caveats: Estimates for the wider Population Health Area, assigned to towns by PHIDU in proportion to population. They are not hospital records for this town.

Standardised ratios compare the area with Australia (= 100) after allowing for age (indirect standardisation). They give a guide to whether the area's rate is, for example, about twice or half the national rate, not a precise town figure.
PHIDU advises extra care where a town has a larger share of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander residents than the wider area it draws from.
Public hospitals only, counted by where patients live. Hospital data scope differs between states and territories, so comparisons across state borders need care.

statusText.suppressed: Not published for this area: PHIDU suppresses small numbers.
statusText.not_available: Not available from PHIDU for this area.
statusText.not_interpretable: Not shown: the source lists zero for every hospital and emergency department measure for this town, the same pattern as records with no residents, so it most likely means no data were assigned rather than no admissions.
